name: io.github.epistemedeus/ein-llc
title: EIN.LLC: Form a US company
description: US company + EIN in any state. 299 USD + state fee. Agent prepares; person reviews and pays.

tools.name: prepare_application
tools.description: Get a private claimUrl for the customer to review and pay, free to prepare. Stores a provisional application. Use the qualifying assessmentId, the intended recipient email and a stable operationId to recover the same application after a lost reply.

intendedEmail.description: Trimmed/lowercased; invalid or missing email produces an incomplete application, not a claim token.

assessmentId.description: When present, the server-stored assessment is bound in one transaction with the application and authority. Same assessment plus intended email recovers the same application when the stored preparation matches. Facts and intended recipient must match the stored assessment. A different assessment cannot reuse an explicit operationId.

hasUsEntity.description: Other values are treated as unknown, not rejected.

hasEin.description: Other values are treated as unknown, not rejected.

jurisdictionKnown.description: Other values are treated as unknown, not rejected.

providerRequiresUsEntity.description: Other values are treated as unknown, not rejected.

providerRequiresEin.description: Other values are treated as unknown, not rejected.

intendedEmail.description: Optional. When a valid email is supplied it is stored on the assessment; later prepare must use the same recipient. Invalid values are ignored, not rejected.

operationId.description: Optional caller idempotency key for a bound prepare. Trimmed and limited to 200 characters. When omitted, the key is prepare:{assessmentId}:{intendedEmailNormalized} and is specific to that assessment and recipient, and a missing key still recovers the application already bound to that assessment. An explicit key is not namespaced by assessment: it determines one durable application id. Reusing it for a different assessment returns 409 operation_identity_conflict. Supplying a different explicit key when this assessment is already bound returns the same 409, does not reserve that key, and returns no claim token. The same assessment with a different stored preparation returns 409 operation_payload_mismatch. Both leave the application, assessment, and authority unchanged and return no claim token. The same assessment, recipient, and stored preparation returns the original application and claim token and does not write again.

operatorRequestsExistingFormationAssista.description: Optional. Accepted only when exactly true. With a stored assessmentId, an eligible insufficient_information assessment (goal present, no US entity, EIN not already held, no affirmed provider entity or EIN-only requirement) can issue a provisional non-actionable claim. The flag does not affirm a provider requirement, recommend formation, or authorize filing, quote, or payment. String values are refused. Omitted on every other path, including required_for_selected_path.

assessmentOutcome.description: Fallback when preparation.assessmentOutcome is absent and no assessmentId/assessment is bound. Trimmed/truncated to 80 characters. Unknown values are refused. already_satisfied and not_needed_now are refused. insufficient_information cannot issue a claim token unless operatorRequestsExistingFormationAssistance is exactly true on an eligible stored assessment. A caller enum is not a server recommendation. Unbound allowed enum remains provisional advice, not actionable authorization.

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Get the application stage and next action using an owner-issued, expiring status grant. Requires applicationId and AgentGrant; the grant is scoped to that application. Returns redacted status.

AgentGrant.description: Revocable, expiring status-only token issued by the owner. Not a Firebase ID token. Pass this value as the bearer token, the same Authorization header the HTTP route expects. Not a Firebase ID token.

tools.name: get_formation_contract
tools.description: Get the current OpenAPI document with input fields and response schemas for formation assessment, application preparation and status.

tools.name: compare_states
tools.description: Get filing fees, annual costs and registered-agent requirements for Wyoming, Delaware, New Mexico, Florida, Texas and California, with government sources and retrieval dates.

tools.name: explain_ein_route
tools.description: Get IRS EIN application channels for the applicant's SSN or ITIN status and principal business location, plus EIN.LLC's qualifying 2 to 3 business day delivery route.

tools.name: get_compliance_deadlines
tools.description: Get dated filing obligations for the supplied company facts, with government sources. Form 5472 depends on entity status and reportable transactions; missing facts return a review-needed result. The calendar is available through the HTTP contract.
